title: Good quality
text: Good quality. May not be any known brand but they are great and work fantastic so far, not sure I would precisely use them only for the kitchen perse but they could be used for a variety of purposes and they proved great for storing the incredible amount of small cables I have also my cat's stuff and other kitchen stuff as well but I think these are great for storing things that you'd prefer stay in there for longer or you don't use every single day in my opinion but of course you can use them for whatever you want. I honestly don't know how long the lock feature works for or if it would withstand harsher use like for the fridge or storing food something like that because I don't need them specifically for that but I found them the perfect size I mean they are pretty spacious and great for storing just about anything and locking feature works great at least for the price I can't complain I think these are a great find here.

product_metadata.title: DWËLLZA KITCHEN Pasta Storage Containers for Pantry Airtight - 4 Pc Spaghetti Container Storage - Ideal for Spaghetti & Noodles, Kitchen Pantry Organization and Storage - Keeps Food Fresh & Dry
features: Perfect For Pantry Organization: This container set includes 4 airtight containers (2.95 qt / 2.8 liters), which are perfect for storing Spaghetti, Noodles & Pasta it can also be stored baking supplies, oats, pasta, rice, flour, sugar, coffee, tea, snacks, nuts and even a small box of cereal, This set comes in a beautiful box which makes it an ideal gift for any friend or family.

Stackable & Space Saving Design: These Durable Bins have been especially designed to minimize space, they are stackable so these plastic storage containers will make more efficient use of every inch of your home kitchen freezer or cupboard. which enables you to get the kitchen organized and frees up space in the pantry.

Airtight Seal & Keeps Food Fresh: The side-locking lids with black silicone seal ensure that no air or water enters in, always keeping your favorite snacks super fresh and dry. These clear Containers are also easy to clean, dishwasher safe, extremely user friendly and ready to use.

8 Reusable Labels: These labels will help you never confuse flour with powdered sugar or baking powder with baking soda. They are reusable, you can switch contents whenever you need, comes also with a marker so it is ready to get it in use.

High Quality: Made of high-quality food grade plastic, BPA free, contain no harmful substances, Its durable enough for long-lasting use, easy to storage when its not in use placing one in to the other.
